cues.text: Let's make something in Podor.

captions.text: Let's make something in Podor.

cues.text: Press Control N to open a new canvas.

captions.text: Press Control N to open a new canvas.

cues.text: Set the width to twelve hundred pixels, and the height to nine hundred. Create your canvas, and start with a clean page.

captions.text: Set the width to twelve hundred pixels, and the height to nine hundred.
Create your canvas, and start with a clean page.

cues.text: Open the color panel and enter a Bordeaux red.

captions.text: Open the color panel and enter a Bordeaux red.

cues.text: Choose Ink. Increase the size, then draw a continuous line across the canvas.

captions.text: Choose Ink.
Increase the size, then draw a continuous line across the canvas.

cues.text: Switch to Soft for a diffused edge.

captions.text: Switch to Soft for a diffused edge.

cues.text: Now try Marker. The same movement produces a different finish. Compare the three marks before choosing your brush.

captions.text: Now try Marker.
The same movement produces a different finish.
Compare the three marks before choosing your brush.

cues.text: Open Color. Drag around the ring to choose a hue, then move inside the square to adjust brightness and saturation.

captions.text: Open Color.
Drag around the ring to choose a hue, then move inside the square to adjust brightness and saturation.

cues.text: Add this color to your palette. Choose another swatch and save that too, ready for your next stroke.

captions.text: Add this color to your palette.
Choose another swatch and save that too, ready for your next stroke.

cues.text: Here is a layered study. Toggle the foreground off and on to see how the image is built.

captions.text: Here is a layered study.
Toggle the foreground off and on to see how the image is built.

cues.text: Duplicate the active layer, then open its blending controls.

captions.text: Duplicate the active layer, then open its blending controls.

cues.text: Try Multiply and watch the colors deepen. Return to Normal, and confirm the result.

captions.text: Try Multiply and watch the colors deepen.
Return to Normal, and confirm the result.

cues.text: Press M and drag a rectangle around part of the painting.

captions.text: Press M and drag a rectangle around part of the painting.

cues.text: Copy the visible selection with Control Shift C. Paste it onto a new layer, then clear the selection with Control D.

captions.text: Copy the visible selection with Control Shift C. Paste it onto a new layer, then clear the selection with Control D.

cues.text: Press Control T to transform the pasted layer.

captions.text: Press Control T to transform the pasted layer.

cues.text: Drag the artwork into position, then press Enter to apply the move.

captions.text: Drag the artwork into position, then press Enter to apply the move.

cues.text: Use Undo to step back through the move and the paste. The original composition is still there.

captions.text: Use Undo to step back through the move and the paste.
The original composition is still there.

cues.text: Open Adjust, then Curves.

captions.text: Open Adjust, then Curves.

cues.text: Add a point and lift the curve. Watch the active layer brighten as you drag.

captions.text: Add a point and lift the curve.
Watch the active layer brighten as you drag.

cues.text: Toggle the preview to compare with the original. Apply the change when the balance feels right.

captions.text: Toggle the preview to compare with the original.
Apply the change when the balance feels right.

cues.text: Copy a reference image, then press Control Shift V to place it on the canvas.

captions.text: Copy a reference image, then press Control Shift V to place it on the canvas.

cues.text: Drag it beside your work. Pull a corner to resize it without changing its proportions.

captions.text: Drag it beside your work.
Pull a corner to resize it without changing its proportions.

cues.text: References stay separate from the painting. They will not appear in your export, and are kept only for this session.

captions.text: References stay separate from the painting.
They will not appear in your export, and are kept only for this session.

cues.text: Open Export to prepare the finished image.

captions.text: Open Export to prepare the finished image.

cues.text: Choose JPEG for a flat image, or PSD for supported pixel layers.

captions.text: Choose JPEG for a flat image, or PSD for supported pixel layers.

cues.text: For this study, choose PNG and export. The reference stays out of the final image.

captions.text: For this study, choose PNG and export.
The reference stays out of the final image.

cues.text: Save the editable project, then return home. Your recent work is ready to open again.

captions.text: Save the editable project, then return home.
Your recent work is ready to open again.

cues.text: From the first mark to the finished piece. Podor.

captions.text: From the first mark to the finished piece.
Podor.
